item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-09 12:00
Institution: Politecnico MILANO, Milan
Field: Industrial and information engineering / 09/IINF-04 Automatica

The research programme focuses on the development of Foundation Models for estimation and control of dynamical systems, with applications in automotive, mechatronics, and robotics. The activities will investigate In-Context Learning methodologies to develop estimators and controllers capable of adapting to different systems and operating conditions without retraining. Learning approaches based on simulated and experimental data will be explored, with particular emphasis on generalization, robustness, and zero-shot transfer to real-world systems. The proposed methodologies will be validated through simulations and experimental applications.

The context of the energy transition demands prompt interventions to mitigate climate-altering emissions. Numerous technologies, such as hydrogen production and carbon capture and storage (CCS), offer short-term solutions to reduce emissions while fostering decarbonization, while also providing long-term management for residual emissions-producing activities. The primary objective of the proposed research activity is the analysis and development of modeling tools to evaluate sustainability and assess risks in technologies for the energy transition.

Advanced data analysis will separate acoustic and hydrodynamic velocities near the wall. The numerical database will enable comparison of inverse methods, reveal the physical causes of anomalous results and support physics-based corrections.
